zh: 哈……哈……这鬼楼梯……总算……上来了……
en: Ha... ha... this damned staircase... finally... made it up…

zh: 我侧身挤进铁门，整个人几乎虚脱，靠在门板上大口喘气
en: I squeezed sideways through the iron door, utterly spent, leaning against the door and gulping for air.

zh: 缺乏锻炼的下场就是，爬这六层楼简直要了半条命，我像条脱水的鱼一样大口喘气
en: This is what a lack of exercise gets you—climbing six floors almost cost me half my life. I’m gasping like a fish out of water.

zh: 这个点……学校天台应该没人吧？
en: At this hour... there shouldn’t be anyone on the school rooftop, right?

zh: 可千万别有人……好不容易才溜上来
en: Please let there be no one... it took so much effort to sneak up here.

zh: <color=#FF0000>逃课上来要是被抓，那可就不是写检讨那么简单了</color>
en: <color=#FF0000>If I get caught cutting class to come up here, it won’t just be writing a self-criticism.</color>

zh: 学校纪律处的那帮人，一张处分单下来，这学期直接就完蛋了
en: Those people in the discipline office—one disciplinary notice and this semester is basically over.

zh: 刚才在五楼楼梯口，差点就跟下楼的教务主任对脸撞上
en: Back at the fifth-floor landing, I almost smashed face-first into the Academic Affairs Director coming down.

zh: 他正盯着文件往楼下走，我贴在冰凉的侧墙上，呼吸都快停了
en: He was staring at his documents as he walked downstairs; I pressed against the cold side wall, barely breathing.

zh: 幸好他突然拐进办公室了……吓死我了
en: Luckily he suddenly turned into an office... scared me to death.

zh: 终于到学校天台了！反正这节课我是绝对不会回去了
en: Finally made it to the school rooftop! Anyway, I’m definitely not going back to class this period.
